Uses **LangGraph** StateGraph with a SQLite checkpointer, per official docs, and sends work to NATS/JetStream. ([LangChain][1])

> `apps/mca-orchestrator/src/types.ts`
```ts export type Gate = "G0" | "G1" | "G2" | "G3" | "G4" | "BUDGET";
export interface Evidence { gate: Gate; status: "PASS" | "FAIL"; ts: string; reason?: string; artifacts?: Record<string, string>; }
export interface State { execId: string; userIntent: string; budgetLimit: number; budgetUsed: number; tasks: Array<{ id: string; kind: string; desc: string }>; gateEvidence: Evidence[]; artifacts: Record<string, string>; } ```
> `apps/mca-orchestrator/src/graph/natsAdapter.ts`
```ts import { connect, StringCodec, NatsConnection } from "nats"; const sc = StringCodec();
export type WorkKind = "plan"|"design"|"implement"|"run"|"scan"|"qualify"|"cost-check"|"db-op";
export class WorkBus { private nc!: NatsConnection;
async init() { this.nc = await connect({ servers: process.env.NATS_URL || "nats://localhost:4222" }); }
async request<T = any>(kind: WorkKind, payload: object, timeoutMs = 60000): Promise<T> { if (!this.nc) throw new Error("NATS not initialized"); const subj = `work.${kind}.request`; const msg = await this.nc.request(subj, sc.encode(JSON.stringify(payload)), { timeout: timeoutMs }); return JSON.parse(sc.decode(msg.data)) as T; } } ```
> `apps/mca-orchestrator/src/graph/gates.ts`
```ts import { State, Evidence, Gate } from "../types";
export function recordGate(state: State, gate: Gate, pass: boolean, reason?: string, artifacts?: Record<string,string>): State { const ev: Evidence = { gate, status: pass ? "PASS" : "FAIL", ts: new Date().toISOString(), reason, artifacts }; return { ...state, gateEvidence: [...state.gateEvidence, ev] }; } ```

## ❌ The Problem
The initial `.aidigest` and `CONSTITUTION.md` inherited constraints from the old monolith's `ai-stack.json`:
```yaml FORBIDDEN_FRAMEWORKS=react,vue,angular,svelte FORBIDDEN_LANGUAGES=ruby,php,java,go,rust ```
**This was WRONG for microservices architecture because:**
1. **Different services have different needs** (UI ≠ API ≠ Security ≠ Runner) 2. **We're building a PRODUCT that competes with Replit, Cursor, GitHub Copilot** 3. **Premium UI requires modern frameworks** (React, Next.js, etc.) 4. **Performance-critical services need Go/Rust** (runner sandboxing, security scanning)
---
## ✅ The Solution
